name: Canon Inc.
summary: Canon Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, sells, and services various printing, medical, imaging, and industrial equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. It operates through four segments: Printing Business Unit, Medical Business Unit, Imaging Business Unit, and Industrial Business Unit.
